{{Short description|American chemist}}
'''Larry James Kevan''' (December 12, 1938 – June 4, 2002) was an American chemist.

Kevan was born in [[Kansas City, Missouri]] on December 12, 1938, and attended the [[University of Kansas]] to study chemistry. Upon completing his undergraduate degree in 1960, Kevan pursued doctoral study at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]], under the direction of [[Willard Libby]].  After obtaining his doctorate in 1963, Kevan became a postdoctoral researcher at the [[Newcastle University|University of Newcastle]], then returned to the United States later that year to serve as a chemistry instructor at the [[University of Chicago]]. Between 1965 and 1969, Kevan taught at the University of Kansas. Kevan left his alma mater for a position at [[Wayne State University]].<ref name="ptobit"/><ref name="hchronobit"/> During his eleven-year tenure at Wayne State, Kevan was awarded a Guggenheim fellowship in 1969,<ref>{{cite news |title=Larry Kevan |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/all-fellows/larry-kevan/ |access-date=January 28, 2022 |publisher=John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation}}</ref> and elected to fellowship of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1972.<ref>{{cite news |title=APS Fellow Archive |url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=K&year=2021&unit_id=&institution= |access-date=January 28, 2022 |publisher=American Physical Society}}</ref> He joined the [[University of Houston]] faculty in 1980, where he was the Cullen Distinguished Professor of Chemistry at the time of his death on June 4, 2002.<ref name="ptobit">{{cite journal |last1=Bales |first1=Barney L. |last2=Schwartz |first2=Robert N. |last3=Bowman |first3=Michael K. |title=Larry Kevan |journal=Physics Today |date=April 1, 2003 |volume=56 |issue=4 |pages=82–83 |doi=10.1063/1.1580066|doi-access=free |bibcode=2003PhT....56d..82B }}</ref><ref name="hchronobit">{{cite news |title=Larry Kevan |url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/houstonchronicle/name/larry-kevan-obituary?id=28378061 |access-date=January 28, 2022 |work=Houston Chronicle |date=June 5, 2002}}</ref>
